nodes.summary: For a noncrossing partition $P$ of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ and a point $a \in \{0, \dots, n-1\}$, the block of $P$ at $a$ is the block of the underlying set partition that contains $a$.
nodes.title: Block of a noncrossing partition

nodes.summary: A set partition $P$ of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ has a crossing if there are $a < b < c < d$ in $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ such that $a$ and $c$ lie in the same block of $P$, $b$ and $d$ lie in the same block of $P$, and these two blocks are different.
nodes.title: Crossing in a set partition

nodes.summary: For every $n \le 3$, every set partition of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is noncrossing.
nodes.title: Partitions of at most three points are noncrossing

nodes.summary: A set partition of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is noncrossing if it has no crossing.
nodes.title: Noncrossing set partition

nodes.summary: A noncrossing partition of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is a set partition of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ that is noncrossing.
nodes.title: Noncrossing partition

nodes.summary: A set partition of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is a finite collection of nonempty, pairwise disjoint subsets of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$, called blocks, whose union is $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$.
nodes.title: Set partition

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
